name: Bramble Knotwright the Third
description: Bands that go over, under and over again, and never end. The first two Knotwrights are still looking for the end.

designs.title: Square Plait
designs.description: A square panel of unbroken plaitwork, every crossing over then under, with four corner studs.

designs.title: Long Panel
designs.description: A tall knotted band between two rules, sized for a forearm or the length of a spine.

designs.title: Round Knot
designs.description: Two waving bands laced into a ring around an eight-pointed star. Good on a shoulder cap.

designs.title: Three-Loop Knot
designs.description: A three-lobed knot with a ring laced through its loops and a star at the very middle.

designs.title: Triple Spiral
designs.description: Three spirals uncoiling from one point inside a dotted ring. Very old idea, still good.
